svg.text: A single series-tap ladder supports 4, 6, 8 or 10 normally-open switches. Only one switch is detected at a time.
ELECTRICAL REVIEW | Prototype circuit; verify on hardware before final assembly.
Each extension receives TAIL + GND and adds 2 x 1k.
Optional LED harness adds +5V and DOUT -> next DIN.
No terminating resistor at the final tail. All resistors 1%.
Select installed count in software, then capture calibration.
Left/right enclosure setting changes visual order only.
Idle: 2200mV at 3.300V. Values are nominal; calibrate the assembled ladder.
